project_rich.label: Chen Residence
project_rich.query_used: select p.id, p.name, count(f.id) ffe_count from projects p join document_state ds on ds.project_id=p.id left join project_ffe_items f on f.project_id=p.id where ds.designer_id='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004' and ds.engagement_kind='project' group by p.id, p.name order by ffe_count desc; -- tied with Olsen Lake House (3 ffe_items, 4 purchase_orders each) — Chen chosen to match prior-program precedent (document-wayfinding-directions-2026-08-25) and the plan's own expectation

project_plain.label: Marrow & Vale Residence
project_plain.query_used: select project_id, title, active_section, item_count from document_state where designer_id='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004' and engagement_kind='project'; -- only project-stage doc with item_count=0 (0 project_ffe_items)

proposal_sent.label: Aspen Loft — Living Room Refresh
proposal_sent.query_used: select proposal_id, title, proposal_status, proposal_sent_at from document_state where designer_id='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004' and engagement_kind='proposal' and proposal_status='sent'; -- only sent proposal on this DB

install.label: Aspen Loft Refresh
install.query_used: select project_id, title, active_section, current_phase from document_state where project_id='b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d1'; -- was active_section='project' after a DB reseed (no project currently at 'install'); lifted via the exact idempotent RPC chain from the wayfinding program (research/lift-install.sql, ported verbatim from artifacts/document-wayfinding-directions-2026-08-25/research/lift-states.sql): expire_client_decision(c301 signoff blocker) -> advance_project_phase(c102) -> advance_project_phase(c103). No raw table writes; designer-authorized RPCs only. Post-lift verified active_section='install', current_phase='installation'.

brief.label: Full Room
brief.query_used: select lead_id, title, lead_status, active_section, lead_response_deadline from document_state where designer_id='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004' and engagement_kind='lead' order by lead_response_deadline nulls last; -- earliest-deadline lead (status='viewed', deadline 2026-08-31); pre-existing, no write needed
